VF-11 modified as a variable fighter for Sound Force
Mylene's unit, notable for its feminine form
SP Song
Fire Valkyrie

VF-19 Kai Fire Valkyrie (Basara)
Modified VF-19. Its bright red frame carries big speakers and speaker pods, and it flew across the galaxy blasting Basara's songs.

VF-19 modified as a variable fighter for Sound Force
Basara's unit, in his personal color of fiery red

Fz-109A Elgersoln (Standard)
Variable fighter flown by regular Varauta Army pilots. Said to be based on the U.N. Forces' VF-14, but this is unconfirmed.

Variable fighter modified by the Protodeviln
Mainly used by regular soldiers

Fz-109F Elgersoln (Gigile)
Commander Fz-109. Flown mainly by Gigile, it attacked Basara and co. time and again. Shot down over City 7 by Gamlin's team.

Variable fighter modified by the Protodeviln
Gigile's unit, with stronger weapons and engine thrust

Glavil
Gavil's body. It needs lots of Spiritia, so Gavil takes a small spirit form, but merges with it as Gavigla to fight all-out.
rows.notes: Glavil gender unknown; sentence kept on Gavil (male).

rows.en:
Protodeviln
A monster of low intelligence, but with powerful weapons

Gepelnitchi
Protodeviln leader. To build a world of endless Spiritia, he attacks humans, the "Spiritia-regenerating race" he sought.
rows.notes: Corner brackets rendered as double quotes.

rows.en:
Varauta Army commander and Protodeviln leader
The largest and mightiest of the Protodeviln

VF-171 Nightmare Plus (Standard)
Main variable fighter of the Macross Frontier fleet. Weaker than the VF-17 it is based on, but easier for regular pilots to handle.
rows.notes: Frontier fleet = Macross Frontier fleet per glossary alias.

rows.en:
Multipurpose variable fighter based on the VF-17
Mainly used by regular soldiers

VF-171 Nightmare Plus EX
A VF-171 fitted with a FAST Pack.
Mainly used by commanders.
rows.notes: Non-WRAP row with three source lines; kept three lines. FAST Pack per glossary packs.

rows.en:
Variable fighter: a VF-171 fitted with a FAST Pack
Mainly used by commanders
rows.notes: Source: variable fighter that is a VF-171 equipped with a FAST Pack.

rows.en:
VF-25F Messiah (Alto)
Cutting-edge unit deployed to military provider S.M.S., partly for testing. A wide range of options made it a superb all-domain fighter.

Latest-model variable fighter issued to S.M.S.
Alto's unit, the standard type

VF-25S Messiah (Ozma)
Gray unit flown by Ozma, leader of S.M.S.'s Skull Squadron. Outperforms standard units and hits hard with Armored Parts.
rows.notes: Armored Parts kept as the source says (not Armored Pack).

rows.en:
Latest-model variable fighter issued to S.M.S.
Ozma's unit, an upgraded commander type

VF-25G Messiah (Michel)
VF-25 customized for long-range combat, painted blue for Michel. Notable for its sniper rifle and long-range head.
rows.notes: Source says Michel here (title and body).

rows.en:
Latest-model variable fighter issued to S.M.S.
Michael's unit, a long-range sniper type

RVF-25 Messiah (Luca)
Electronic-warfare custom VF-25; Luca's is light green. Carries a large rear radome and remote-controlled drone fighters.

Latest-model variable fighter issued to S.M.S.
Luca's unit, an electronic warfare type
Ghost Frenzy

VF-27 Lucifer (Brera)
High-end unit that outclasses the VF-25. Its agility exceeds what humans can endure, so only the body-modified Brera flies it.
rows.notes: Body-modified = cybernetically altered body; kept plain.

rows.en:
Mysterious variable fighter of unknown affiliation
Its combat ability far surpasses the VF-25

Queadluun-Rhea (Standard)
Advanced Queadluun-Rau with an added rear beam cannon and stronger arm weapons. Mainly the Pixie Team's mainstay.

Battle suit upgraded from the Queadluun-Rau
Mainly used by regular soldiers

Queadluun-Rhea (Klan)
Klan's red unit. Being a powered-suit-like machine, it pairs with Klan's own high combat ability to become formidable.

Battle suit upgraded from the Queadluun-Rau
Klan's unit, with crimson as her personal color
Battle Frontier

Battle Frontier
Super-large multipurpose stealth attack space carrier, key to the defense of Macross Frontier.
rows.notes: Source paragraph ends mid-sentence in Japanese layout only; full sentence.

rows.en:
Flagship of the 21st New Macross-class colony fleet
Its technology ranks among the best in the galaxy

Vajra (S)
Small insect-like alien. Fires energy cannons and missile-like guided weapons from its head; its bladed tail allows melee.

Vajra, an alien life form
Has a variety of weapons and high mobility

Vajra (L)
Vajra 5+ times the small type's size. Strong attacks: a big rear beam that smashes battleships in one hit, missiles, autocannon-like arms.

Vajra, an alien life form
Carries a powerful large beam cannon on its back
Vajra Queen

Vajra Queen
As the Vajra's command center, it links with all Vajra and controls their actions. A super-dimensional being older than the Protoculture.

Queen of the alien life form Vajra
It is the one that gives orders to the Vajra
Unavailable

VF-0S Phoenix (Roy)
Roy Focker flew it in a new kind of transforming dogfight against his ex-superior "Ivanov", an Anti-U.N. Forces pilot.
rows.notes: Hanntougou-gun = Anti-U.N. Forces per brief. Ivanov in quotes as in the source.

rows.en:
Variable fighter developed as the VF-1 prototype
Focker's unit, with a skull as its trademark

SV-51α (Standard)
Anti-U.N. Forces variable fighter. A novel variable-wing system makes this big craft highly mobile. Fought at Mayan Island.

Variable fighter developed by the Anti-U.N. Forces
Mainly used by regular soldiers

SV-51γ (Nora)
Upgraded SV-51α. Gave U.N. pilot Shin Kudo a hard fight. Abducts Sara, Mayan Island's priestess, who holds the "Bird Human" secret.

Variable fighter developed by the Anti-U.N. Forces
Nora's unit, with magenta as her personal color
Fuel-Air Bomb Drop

SV-51γ (Ivanov)
Ride of Ivanov, Focker's ex-boss. Fought Focker's VF-0S to the death. Charged the Bird Human that downed Nora and was shot down.

Variable fighter developed by the Anti-U.N. Forces
Ivanov's unit, with black as his personal color
